checklist.text: Kundli Upload & File Support: Upload JPG, PNG, PDF, scanned, printed, faded, tilted, noisy, and low-quality Kundli files.
AI OCR & Data Extraction: Extract text, numbers, names, dates, planetary positions, houses, tables, Dasha details, Yogas, Doshas, and other Kundli information.
OCR Verification & Data Correction: Detect uncertain or incorrect OCR results, highlight them, provide a manual correction panel, and validate important astrological data.
Original Data Preservation: Preserve the original astrological information exactly while redesigning the visual presentation and allow users to verify extracted data before rendering.
Automatic Kundli & Chart Detection: Detect North Indian, South Indian, East Indian, Rashi, Navamsa, Lagna, Bhava, divisional charts, planetary charts, and other chart formats.
AI Chart Reconstruction: Digitally recreate detected charts with editable houses, planets, numbers, symbols, labels, borders, and other chart components instead of using the original image.
Editable Kundli Components: Make charts, tables, headings, text blocks, icons, borders, planetary information, and other extracted components fully editable.

Theme & Visual Design System: Provide modern, traditional, premium, minimal, spiritual, royal, and professional Kundli themes with customizable backgrounds, borders, patterns, and decorative elements.
Colors, Fonts & Language Support: Customize colors and typography with support for Hindi, Sanskrit, English, and regional languages, including language conversion where required.
Charts, Icons & Decorative Elements: Provide professionally designed Rashi icons, planetary icons, Om symbols, mandalas, zodiac elements, borders, patterns, and customizable chart styles.
Smart Table Redesign: Automatically detect and redesign planetary tables, house tables, Dasha tables, and other tables with professional styling, spacing, borders, typography, and editable content.

AI Layout & Page Management: Automatically arrange charts, tables, text, and sections with smart alignment, spacing, resizing, multi-page layouts, A4/A5/custom page sizes, and portrait/landscape support.

Professional Kundli Sections & Cover Page: Provide templates for Kundli details, planetary positions, Dasha, Yogas, Doshas, predictions, cover pages, headers, footers, page numbers, photos, and contact information.
Drag & Drop Design Editor: Allow users to move, resize, rearrange, align, and customize every individual component through an easy visual editor with undo and redo.
Branding & Custom Templates: Support logos, business branding, watermarks, reusable customer profiles, saved design presets, and reusable custom templates for astrologers.

AI Design Generator & Multiple Variations: Generate multiple professional design variations from the same Kundli and provide AI recommendations for colors, fonts, layouts, themes, and overall presentation.
Live Preview & Comparison: Provide real-time design preview, original versus redesigned comparison, and instant updates while editing.

Quality Control & AI Final Check: Automatically check for OCR mistakes, missing information, overlapping elements, cut-off charts, poor alignment, unreadable fonts, spacing issues, and other export problems.
Export, Printing & Bulk Processing: Export high-resolution PDF, PNG, JPG, and print-ready files, while supporting bulk Kundli processing with the same selected design or template.

Astrologer Mode & Client-Safe Workflow: Provide a professional workflow for astrologers to manage repeated Kundli generation, preserve verified data, maintain version history, restore previous designs, and ensure the final exported Kundli exactly matches the approved preview.

title: Epic: Customer Support Ticketing Dashboard
Ticket Creation
description: Story 1 — Create Ticket from Website

title: Story 1 — Create Ticket from Website
description:
User story:
 As a customer, I want my website support or return request to automatically create a ticket so that my issue is recorded immediately.
Acceptance criteria :
A valid website support/return submission creates a ticket automatically.
A unique Ticket ID is generated.
Customer information is captured.
Order ID is linked where available.
Issue description is captured.
Attachments are linked to the ticket.
Ticket Type = Issue.
Channel = Website.
Source = Auto.
Status = New.
Category = Uncategorized.
Creation timestamp is recorded.
Ticket enters the appropriate Issue queue.
Customer receives a ticket acknowledgement.

title: Story 2 — Create Ticket from Email
description:
User story
 As a support agent, I want inbound customer emails to automatically create tickets so that customer issues are not lost in email.
Acceptance criteria
Inbound email creates a ticket.
Email subject is stored.
Email body is stored.
Attachments are linked.
Customer is matched by email where possible.
Order ID is linked where available.
Ticket Type = Issue.
Channel = Email.
Source = Auto.
Ticket starts in New.
Unique Ticket ID is generated.
Ticket enters the Issue queue.
Customer receives acknowledgement.
Replies to an existing ticket are added to the existing ticket where applicable.

title: Create Ticket from WhatsApp
description:
User story
 As a support agent, I want inbound WhatsApp messages to automatically create or update tickets so that WhatsApp conversations are tracked centrally.
Acceptance criteria
Inbound WhatsApp message triggers ticket processing through the configured Business API/webhook.
Customer is identified using phone number where possible.
Message content is captured.
Supported media is attached.
Ticket Type = Issue.
Channel = WhatsApp.
Source = Auto.
Existing open ticket is checked before creating a new ticket.
Ticket enters the Issue queue.
Customer receives acknowledgement when a new ticket is created.

title: Story 4 — Create Ticket from Phone/IVR
description:
User story
 As a support agent, I want inbound calls to automatically generate tickets when the call arrives so that the interaction is recorded from the beginning.
Acceptance criteria
Ticket is created when an inbound call lands.
Caller phone number is captured.
Customer is matched where possible.
Call timestamp is recorded.
IVR metadata is captured where available.
Call recording link is attached where available.
Ticket Type = Issue.
Channel = Phone.
Source = Auto.
Ticket starts in New.
Ticket enters the Issue queue.
The agent handling the call can be associated with the ticket.

title: Story 5 — Create Ticket from In-App Support
description:
User story
 As a customer, I want to raise a support request from the app so that my issue is automatically tracked.
Acceptance criteria
Customer can submit an in-app support request.
Ticket is automatically created after successful submission.
Customer information is linked.
Order ID is linked where available.
Description is captured.
Attachments are supported.
Ticket Type = Issue.
Channel = In-App.
Source = Auto.
Ticket starts as New.
Ticket enters the Issue queue.
Customer receives acknowledgement.

title: Story 6 — Manually Create Ticket
description:
User story
 As a support agent, I want to manually create a ticket so that issues from unsupported channels can still be tracked.
Acceptance criteria
Agent can select Create Ticket.
Agent can search for an existing customer.
Agent can create a ticket for an unmatched customer.
Agent can enter/select an order ID.
Agent can select the channel.
Agent can select Ticket Type.
Agent can enter issue description.
Agent can add attachments.
Required fields are validated.
Unique Ticket ID is generated.
Source = Manual.
Ticket enters the queue associated with its Ticket Type.
Ticket follows the same assignment and lifecycle rules as automatically created tickets.

title: Story 7 — Detect Duplicate Tickets
description:
User story
 As a support agent, I want the system to detect potential duplicate issues so that the same customer problem isn't handled multiple times.
Acceptance criteria
System checks for existing open tickets for the same customer/order.
Potential duplicate tickets are flagged.
Existing Ticket ID is displayed.
Agent can open the existing ticket.
Agent can associate the new interaction with the existing ticket.
New messages can be added to the existing ticket timeline.
Uncertain matches are not automatically merged.
Duplicate/merge activity is logged.
